title: Bali Couple Escape | Sea, Sunsets & Sands
highlights: Enjoy a perfect Bali escape, where jungle adventures, sacred temples, scenic views, and romantic moments create memories to last a lifetime.
Ride through Bali’s scenic countryside on a Volkswagen vintage car tour, where classic charm meets breathtaking landscapes.
Rejuvenate at Bali’s handpicked spas, with authentic therapies, serene settings, and exclusive deals of up to 50% off.
Stay at handpicked hotels offering beachfront views, spacious rooms, and trusted brands for a comfortable Bali retreat.
Capture timeless memories with a free 1-hour photoshoot at Sari Timbul, set against stunning and picture-perfect backdrops.
overview:
About the Tour:
Begin your Bali getaway in a beautifully decorated room that sets the tone for relaxation. During the tour, discover the charm of Tegenungan Waterfall and soar above lush valleys on the Bali Swing. Walk through the stunning Tegallalang Rice Terraces and experience spiritual calm at Tirta Empul. Also, visit the iconic Handara Gate, the serene Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, and the Bali Botanical Garden. Enjoy an adventurous Jungle ATV ride before heading to Nusa Penida to explore Kelingking Beach, Angel’s Billabong, Broken Bay, and Crystal Bay. Unwind with a floating breakfast and soothing Balinese massage in Kuta. End your journey with a romantic candlelight dinner and a visit to Uluwatu Temple, where a dramatic sunset and the fiery Kecak Dance offer a magical finale.

exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.

Where your itinerary mentions “local lunch,” it refers to an authentic Balinese meal featuring traditional flavors and dishes. Indian food will not be served during these local lunch experiences unless specifically mentioned.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, get driven to Ubud. Once there, check in to your hotel and settle your beautifully decorated room. Spend the day at leisure, where you can relax at the hotel or explore nearby attractions. You can visit Goa Gajah, the ancient ‘Elephant Cave’ adorned with mystical carvings or wander through Bali Bird Park to spot exotic species in lush habitats. Also, you can relax at Waterbom Bali, a world-class waterpark famed for its thrilling rides.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen
days.desc: Start your morning with a complimentary floating breakfast. Then, embark on a Central Bali Volkswagen vintage car tour, where timeless style meets scenic countryside views. Experience unlimited rides on the iconic Bali Swing, soaring above lush valleys, before visiting the beautiful Tegenungan Waterfall. Next, visit Tirta Empul Temple, renowned for its sacred spring pools, & capture memories with a photoshoot at Sari Timbul. Conclude your day at the UNESCO-listed Tegallalang Rice Terrace.

items.title: Transfer in Vintage Volkswagen
items.desc: 1 X Vintage Volkswagen will be Provided

items.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul Temple - Bali Swing + Tegenungan Waterfall + Tirta Empul + Sari Timbul + Tegallang Rice Terrace Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen

days.title: Visit to Mt Batur | Kintamani  Highlands & Batur Hot Spring | Balinese Massage
days.desc: Embark on an early morning trek to Mt. Batur, where the rewarding hike leads you to a breathtaking sunrise over Bali’s volcanic landscape. After descending, head to the Kintamani Highlands and relax at Batur Hot Springs, where warm volcanic waters soothe your body while you take in stunning views of the lake and mountains. Later, get driven to your hotel. In the evening, get driven to indulge in a traditional Balinese massage, renowned for its healing touch and rejuvenating techniques.

items.title: Mount Batur Trekking in Bali -  Mt Batur + Batur Hot Spring + Kintamani Highland Tour
Balinese Massage in Bali - 1-Hour Balinese Massage in Ubud

days.title: ATV Ride & White Water Rafting Experience | Transfer to Kuta
days.desc: After check-out, get driven for an adrenaline-filled ATV ride, navigating through Bali’s rugged trails, rice paddies, and lush jungle paths for the perfect blend of adventure and scenery. Continue the thrill with an exciting whitewater rafting experience, where rushing rapids and stunning Ayung river landscapes create unforgettable moments. After the adventure, get driven to Kuta, where golden beaches and vibrant streets await. Once there, check-in to your hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.

items.title: ATV Adventure in Bali - ATV Ride (Dual Rider) +  White Water Rafting at Ayung River

days.title: Full Day Nusa Penida West Tour with Paluang Cliff
days.desc: Begin your day with a scenic drive to Sanur Port and board a speedboat to Nusa Penida for a west coast adventure. upon arrival, get driven to the Kelingking Beach & marvel at its T-Rex–shaped cliff. Continue to Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool with sparkling waters, and admire the dramatic coastal arch at Broken Bay. Next, visit the Paluang Cliff for a stunning vantage point of Kelingking before ending at Crystal Bay, where golden sands and turquoise waters create a perfect escape.

items.title: Transfer in Speed Boat
items.desc: 1 X Speed Boat will be Provided

items.title: Nusa Penida West Tour - Kelingking Beach + Angel Billabong + Broken Bay + Crystal Bay + Paluang Cliff
Transfer in Speed Boat
items.desc: 1 X Speed Boat will be Provided

days.title: Watersports at Tenjung Benoa | Visit to Melasti Beach Tour | Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire & Dance Show | Kuta Market Visit
days.desc: This morning, get driven to Tanjung Benoa, Bali’s adventure hotspot, where you can opt for thrilling watersports like jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides. After a delicious lunch, visit the Melasti Beach, known for its pristine sands and dramatic limestone cliffs. Later, visit the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched high above the ocean, and witness the stunning Kecak Fire Dance as the sun sets. After an amazing time, explore the colorful stalls and soak-in the lively vibe of Kuta Market.

items.title: Day Trip to Uluwatu Temple - Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach + Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire Dance Show + Melasti Beach + Kuta Market with Lunch

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check-out from your hotel in Kuta. Then, board your transfer and get driven to the airport for your flight back home, this marks the end to your amazing Bali escape, exploring Ubud and Kuta.
